text:
We seek an Intermediate Architect to lead Construction Administration (CA) for a new construction mixed-use multifamily residential affordable housing projects.
You will bridge design intent and field execution, working directly with contractors, consultants, and building officials from mobilization through closeout.
Key Responsibilities
- Lead day-to-day Construction Administration for ground-up multifamily construction.
- Review and process RFIs, shop drawings, submittals, and substitution requests.
- Conduct regular site visits, document progress, and issue field reports and punch lists.
- Track schedule milestones, change order evaluations, and construction quality compliance.
- Coordinate resolution of field conditions with structural, MEP, and civil consultants.
- Support municipal inspections, DOB/code sign-offs, and project closeout documentation.
Qualifications & Skills
- Education & Licensure: B.Arch or M.Arch.
- Experience: 4–7 years of architectural experience, including hands-on CA on ground-up or multifamily projects.
- Detailing & Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in construction detailing (building envelope, waterproofing, and assemblies)
- Revit, and AutoCAD;
- familiarity with construction management tools (such as Oracle Submittal Exchange, Procore, and Bluebeam).
- Sustainability: Passive House experience or certification (CPHC/CPHD) is a plus.
- Code & Construction Knowledge: Working knowledge of NYC Building Code, zoning, and multifamily building systems.
- Organization & Communication: Highly organized, detail-oriented communicator capable of managing contractor expectations and field coordination.
Compensation & Benefits
- Base salary: $90,000
- Health, dental, and vision insurance
- 401(k) plan, paid time off
How to Apply
Submit your resume, portfolio samples showing CA or construction detailing work, and brief project availability.
